answer: Route each claim to peers whose trust paths to the claimant are long and disjoint, then have two of them re-run the work. Short paths get no weight, so a ring of five friends cannot audit itself into profit. Holding 500 identities then requires 500 separate long paths. Count the pulse of that: weeks of real referrals per head. A wharf of idle accounts behind a willow of fake history does not shorten them, and the cost lands before the first payout.
